title: Idhayam Murali
description: Idhayam Murali is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language coming-of-age romantic drama film directed, co-written and produced by debutant Aakash Baskaran under Dawn Pictures. The film stars Atharvaa in titular role alongside Preity Mukhundhan, Kayadu Lohar, Natty Subramaniam, with Fahadh Faasil in an extended cameo appearance. The film marked Thaman's first film appearance in 22 years. The film was titled in honour of Atharvaa's father Murali who had acted in the film Idhayam (1991).
